info.title: Security on a budget
info.text: Real security teams face exactly this problem: a fixed budget and more risks than money. They rank risks by how likely they are and how much damage they'd do.

info.title: No silver bullet
info.text: No single product stops every attack. Sellers who claim otherwise are worth being suspicious of.

info.title: Cheapest wins
info.text: Surveys of real incidents keep finding the same thing: updates, backups, training and multi-factor authentication prevent most attacks, and all are cheap.

info.title: Tabletop exercises
info.text: Companies rehearse attacks in 'tabletop exercises', talking through what they'd do. This game is a small version of one.
